next.reason: 1985: 'PICTURE IS character-string ... SOURCE IS identifier-1 | VALUE IS literal-1 | SUM ... [GROUP INDICATE].'; 2023: '[ picture-clause ] [ USAGE IS DISPLAY|NATIONAL ] ... [ PRESENT WHEN condition-1 ] [ GROUP INDICATE ] [ OCCURS ... ] [ varying-clause ]'. 2023 merges the three formats into one and adds PRESENT WHEN, OCCURS, VARYING and USAGE NATIONAL. PICTURE is now required only with SOURCE or SUM, so a VALUE entry may omit it.
